summary: Promoted the StopSign failure mechanism from interpretation prose to a durable behavior entry: create_log_sync sends the StopSign separately and starts the suffix at the follower's valid entries index; sync_log sets accepted to sync_idx + suffix length and adds one for the StopSign, so when sync_idx already covers it the follower ends accepted one past its last log position and decided can never equal accepted. The control receipt (603faa15c86645c6a56b0b9fadfc0751) is cited for both the failing node and the consistent control. No defect claim changed; all five explained questions and their evidence remain.
